audit.summary: All audit criteria met. Six usable retail product assets with distinct SKUs and one logo asset. No blockers detected. Campaign ready for HTML5 ad code generation. The logo file logos/ikea.svg is the official IKEA brand lockup. It displays the correct "IKEA" wordmark in the recognizable blue letters on a yellow oval background with the registered trademark symbol, matching the official brand identity from the style guide. Colors align with the primary palette (#0058AB blue and #FBD914 yellow). No blockers identified.
